definition: the years at the company, which I have called a special kind of hell

settled:
A company never runs out of steps. It is open-ended, it is never finished, and it never waits.

So it held me in responsibility permanently and everywhere at once, for the whole span of it. That is the special kind of hell.

Nothing I did across those years could be enjoyed for its own sake, because nothing under a held responsibility can be.

It is a large part of why I am not allowed to take responsibility for things now.
